WITH avg_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.CDSCode, 
        sc.School, 
        sc.County, 
        (ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrWrite) / 3 AS AvgScoreAllSubj
    FROM 
        schools sc
    INNER JOIN 
        satscores ss ON sc.CDSCode = ss.cds
),
min_avg_score AS (
    SELECT MIN(AvgScoreAllSubj) AS MinAvgScore
    FROM avg_scores
),
filtered_min_avg_score AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, School, County, AvgScoreAllSubj
    FROM avg_scores
    WHERE AvgScoreAllSubj = (SELECT MinAvgScore FROM min_avg_score)
)
SELECT 
    filtered_min_avg_score.School, 
    filtered_min_avg_score.County, 
    AVG(filtered_min_avg_score.AvgScoreAllSubj) AS AvgMathScore
FROM 
    filtered_min_avg_score;	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT cl.client_id, cl.gender, cl.birth_date, d.A11 AS avg_salary
    FROM client cl
    JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date, avg_salary
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE gender = 'F' AND avg_salary IS NOT NULL
),
age_rank AS (
    SELECT client_id, AVG(julianday(birth_date)) AS avg_birth_date
    FROM c_rows
    GROUP BY client_id
),
oldest_females AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM age_rank
    WHERE avg_birth_date = (SELECT MIN(avg_birth_date) FROM age_rank)
),
min_avg_salary AS (
    SELECT MIN(avg_salary) AS min_sal
    FROM c_rows
),
youngest_female AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM c_rows
    WHERE avg_salary = (SELECT min_sal FROM min_avg_salary)
),
youngest_accounts AS (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM youngest_female)
)
SELECT DISTINCT y.account_id
FROM youngest_accounts y;	----- bird -----	financial
